Data Contract & Metric Dictionary (Veri Sözleşmesi)

Definitive technical and operational specifications for dataset ingestion and KPI computations

1. Dataset Overview & Technical Specifications

This dashboard operates on a standardized, client-side recruitment dataset originating from the corporate Talent Acquisition tracking workbook. It parses and visualizes 5,000 synthetic historical and active requisition lifecycle records.

Active Sheet Name

db (or the primary populated worksheet in the workbook).

Column Structure

Total of 17 physical columns (A to Q). Column A (check_area) is explicitly ignored during ingestion and computation.

Date Encoding

Excel serial day numbers (e.g. 45272 = 2023-12-12) or standard ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Normalized automatically via UTC timestamp conversion.

Offline Portability

100% serverless single-page application. SheetJS is embedded locally for secure client-side parsing with zero network dependencies.

2. Field Dictionary & Schema Mapping

Exact definitions of the 16 active columns ingested from the Excel workbook:

Col Field Key Display Label Data Type Nullability Description & Business Logic
Acheck_areaCheck AreaStringOptionalIgnored Column: Reserved for internal administrative checks. Excluded from all computations and dashboards.
BptfPTF Requisition IDString / NumberMandatoryUnique Position Requisition Identifier. Bulk/mass hires use *** mask.
CunitBusiness UnitStringMandatoryOperating Directorate or Division requesting headcount (e.g. Güvenlik Operasyon, TAYA Yolcu Hizmetleri).
Dposition_namePosition NameStringMandatoryFormal corporate job title of the requested role.
EstatusRequisition StatusStringMandatoryPrimary lifecycle state: Açık (Open), Kapatıldı (Closed / Filled), İptal Edildi (Cancelled).
Fprocess_stepProcess StepStringMandatoryCurrent recruiting sub-step: Teklif Kabul, Ön Eleme, Teklif, Online & Envanter, PSM & Birim.
Ghiring_managerHiring ManagerStringMandatoryName of the departmental director or manager requesting the role.
HresponsibleTA SpecialistStringMandatoryTalent Acquisition specialist / recruiter assigned to manage the requisition.
IcommentOperational NotesStringOptionalFree-text notes including onboarding dates, candidate progress, or special project tags.
Jposition_start_dateOpening DateDate / SerialMandatoryDate the PTF was formally approved and opened for candidate sourcing.
Kposition_levelPosition LevelStringMandatoryOrganizational grade (e.g. Uzman, Uzman Yardımcısı, Sorumlu, Şef).
Llevel_categoryLevel CategoryStringMandatoryManagement tier: Uzman Grubu (Professional), İlk Kademe Yönetici, Orta Kademe, Üst Kademe, C-Level.
Moffer_dateOffer DateDate / SerialOptionalDate the formal job offer was extended to the candidate.
Nhired_employeeHired CandidateStringOptionalFull name of the candidate placed into the position. Empty if position is still open or cancelled.
OresourceSourcing ChannelStringOptionalTalent channel: LinkedIn, Referans (Referral), Agency, Harici (Direct), Kariyer.net.
Prefferal_nameReferral SourceStringOptionalName of internal employee or external source providing the referral.
QgenderCandidate GenderStringOptionalDemographic tag recorded during onboarding: Male or Female.

3. Metric Formulas & Calculation Logic

Mathematical definitions and governance rules for all executive KPIs:

KPI Name Calculation Formula Measurement Unit Rationale & Purpose
Total Requisitions COUNT(records) matching active filters Integer count Measures the total scope of hiring demand handled by the Talent Acquisition organization.
Open Requisitions COUNT(status == "Açık") Count & % of Total Active searches currently in flight that require recruiter attention and operational execution.
Closed Requisitions COUNT(status contains "Kapatıldı") Count & % of Total Successfully filled requisitions where hiring requirements have been satisfied.
Cancelled Requisitions COUNT(status contains "İptal" or "listeden çıkar") Count & % of Total Positions frozen, cancelled by the business unit, or rescinded prior to hire.
Hired Placements COUNT(hired_employee is not empty and not starts with "#") Individual count Verified placed employees who have accepted offers and are scheduled for/have started work.
Time to Offer (Lead Time) (offer_date - position_start_date) in days / 7 in weeks Days & Weeks Cycle time efficiency: tracks calendar duration from PTF requisition approval to formal offer extension. Outliers (<0 or >730 days) excluded.
SLA Risk Alert (>60 Days Open) COUNT(status == "Açık" and (current_date - position_start_date) > 60 days) Count of roles Operational risk indicator flagging open requisitions exceeding the standard 60-day SLA window.
Offer Acceptance Rate (Hired Placements / Total Offers Extended) * 100 Percentage (%) Candidate attraction efficiency: proportion of extended job offers that resulted in placed employees.

4. Standardized Pipeline Funnel Mapping

Rules mapping raw operational Turkish steps and statuses into the 7 standard pipeline stages:

Standard Stage Primary Triggers & Matching Tokens Business Description
New & Sourcing status == "Açık" and (process_step == "Aday Arama" or no candidate yet) Requisition approved, recruiter actively sourcing from talent pool and job boards.
Initial Screening process_step contains "Ön Eleme" Recruiter reviewing CVs and conducting introductory screening calls.
Assessment & Testing process_step contains "Online", "Envanter", "Test", "Sınav", "Wall Street", "MMPI" Skills assessment, cognitive tests, English evaluations, and psychological inventories.
Interview Stage process_step contains "Birim", "Mülakat", "Görüşme", "PSM", "İK" Interviews with Hiring Managers, Technical Committees, and HR Business Partners.
Offer Stage process_step contains "Teklif", "Evrak", "Ücret", "YK Onay" (without finalized hire) Compensation proposal created, executive approvals gathered, formal offer extended.
Hired & Accepted hired_employee is not empty OR process_step == "Teklif Kabul" OR status == "Kapatıldı" Candidate formally accepted offer, documents completed, onboarding initiated.
Archived / Cancelled status contains "İptal", "Listeden Çıkar", "Cancel" Requisitions withdrawn, eliminated from headcounts, or candidates rejected.

Expected File Layout

The importer automatically parses the single sheet db and safely skips Column A (check_area). Headers are verified against standard recruitment keys:

[A: check_area] | B: ptf | C: unit | D: position_name | E: status | F: process_step | G: hiring_manager | H: responsible | I: comment | J: position_start_date | K: position_level | L: level_category | M: offer_date | N: hired_employee | O: resource | P: refferal_name | Q: gender
